title: Scientists Deserve First-Hand Evidence on UAP Materials
author: Avi Loeb
source: Medium / UAP Science Advisory Council policy brief
key_claims: UAP materials of >1g mass could be isotopically/chemically fingerprinted for extrasolar origin
Solid-state structure analysis can distinguish alien manufacturing from human black-projects
Biological materials could be distinguished by non-terrestrial chirality or non-DNA genetic chemistry
Grusch testimony (July 2023) remains unverified without first-hand physical evidence
methodology: Proposed validation framework: isotope-ratio mass spectrometry, X-ray diffraction/crystallography, bio-molecular chirality assays, electron microscopy
key_risk: Conditional premise (existence of retrieved non-human craft) rests on second-hand testimony; intelligence-community disinformation/adversarial-tech mislabeling is a major confounder
next_experiment: If materials are released: perform ICP-MS and TIMS isotopic analysis on >1g samples; compare against solar-system nucleosynthetic baseline. If not: treat as unfalsified L2 hypothesis and redirect resources to Galileo Project multi-sensor triangulation.
notes: Methodology proposed is rigorous L1; the underlying claim of retrieved craft is L2 pending evidence. Entry value lies in the physics-constrained search template for validating extraordinary claims, analogous to MATSCI-004 pipeline.
